name: JRNY
rootCause: On-chain investigator ZachXBT stated on his personal Telegram channel that the wallet associated with crypto KOL JRNY appears to have been compromised, with approximately $4 million worth of crypto assets transferred and sold. This suggests that the wallet's private key may have been leaked.
